llm.summary: This skill is a documented PR-review memory helper that stores and searches review findings, with no evidence of hidden scripts, destructive actions, or data exfiltration.

dimensions.detail: The stated purpose is to capture, classify, store, and retrieve durable knowledge from PR reviews in a memory-palace structure, and the bundled files consistently support that workflow.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: The skill describes automatic capture after a companion PR-review workflow and proactive surfacing of stored entries; this is purpose-aligned but users should expect review findings to be retained for later reuse.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The artifact contains markdown instructions and modules only, with no executable scripts or installer. Metadata lists companion Night Market skills/configs rather than hidden install steps.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill may store PR review content, participants, file references, tags, and optional search indexes. That is proportionate to the purpose but can include sensitive project context.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: Persistent memory entries, backlinks, tags, and indexes are disclosed as core behavior. No privilege escalation, credential use, or external upload requirement is shown in the artifact.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: Install if you want PR-review findings preserved as searchable project memory. Avoid capturing secrets, private customer data, or sensitive internal discussion, and review automatic captures in confidential repositories.
